name: Highway Surfers
desc:
This game is currently in beta so bugs are to be expected.

Hit the gas and throw yourself into fast-paced highway mayhem! 🚗💨
Weave through wild traffic, dodge near-misses, and speed past chaos! 💥💰
Unlock awesome new cars 🚗, master tight gaps 🌀, and push your reflexes to the limit! ⚡

How far can you go before the highway takes you down? 🏁
If you're having a blast, don't forget to hit that thumbs up! 👍😄
